headline: COPPER DUMPS TO 7-WEEK LOW DESPITE SECTION 232 DUE TOMORROW — FED HIKE FEARS BEAT TARIFF PREMIUM AS DOLLAR SURGES
snippet: Copper futures fell to $6.12 per pound Monday — a seven-week low — as expectations of at least one 2026 Federal Reserve rate hike (nine of eighteen Fed officials now forecast a hike per the June 17 dot-plot) and a strengthening U.S. dollar outweighed price support from the incoming Section 232 copper tariff decision, due June 30. The dynamic is a genuine market surprise: for most of Q2, copper's COMEX-over-LME premium — at times exceeding $1,500 per tonne — reflected U.S. traders pre-positioning for tariffs. Today's selloff signals the market is now pricing macro headwinds first. The June 30 report to the White House will formally recommend whether to phase in a 15% levy on refined copper imports from January 2027, rising to 30% in 2028. For junior copper investors the setup is bifurcated: domestic U.S. projects retain materially higher NPV under any tariff scenario, while non-U.S. projects face pure LME pricing exposed to the Fed's rate path — and today's price action is the clearest illustration yet of why jurisdiction increasingly matters in copper project valuation.

headline: MIDNIGHT SUN DUMBWA NOW 6.7KM × 1,000M OF NEAR-SURFACE COPPER — 77 NEW HOLES CONFIRM ZAMBIA SYSTEM BUILT FOR SCALE (TSXV:MMA)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Midnight Sun Mining Corp. (TSXV:MMA)
snippet: Midnight Sun Mining Corp. (TSXV:MMA) reported June 29 results from 77 holes at the Dumbwa copper deposit in Solwezi, Zambia, confirming that the total programme — now surpassing 260 holes and 56,855 metres — has established continuous near-surface sulphide copper mineralisation across a 6.7-kilometre-long, 600-to-1,000-metre-wide, north-south corridor. Highlight intervals include 0.51% copper over 13.7 metres and 0.42% copper over 21.6 metres. Five drill rigs remain active, continuing to push the system northward and laterally. At 6.7 by 1.0 kilometres, Dumbwa is approaching the scale thresholds that historically attract major mining company interest in the Zambian Copperbelt, where geometry and continuity are the primary valuation drivers — and at present the full extent of the system remains open in every direction.

headline: SOUTHERN CROSS GOLD FIRES FIRST UNDERGROUND CUT AT SUNDAY CREEK — 11 RIGS NOW, 24 RIGS UNDERGROUND BY OCTOBER (TSX:SXGC)
source_name: International Mining / Southern Cross Gold Consolidated Ltd. (TSX:SXGC)
snippet: PYBAR Mining Services fired the first cut in the exploration decline portal at Southern Cross Gold Consolidated's Sunday Creek Gold-Antimony Project in Victoria, Australia on June 29, 2026 — marking the transition from surface drilling to underground drill-out. The 680-metre primary decline will reach 115 metres vertical depth, enabling underground drilling platforms by October 2026 and a scale-up from 11 surface rigs currently operating to 24 rigs working concurrently from underground — positioning Sunday Creek as one of the world's largest pre-development drill-out campaigns by active rig count. Sunday Creek is a structurally-hosted gold-antimony system in the Victorian Goldfields, a jurisdiction with established mining infrastructure. The decline-start milestone is the transition between exploration and the resource-definition phase, and the rig-count doubling that follows is what defines a project's ability to deliver high-frequency result flows through the remainder of 2026.

headline: KODIAK TRIPLES MPD COPPER-GOLD TO 16,500M WITH SECOND RIG — KETCHAN PORPHYRY UNTESTED BY KODIAK NOW IN SIGHTS (TSXV:KDK)
snippet: Kodiak Copper Corp. (TSXV:KDK) announced June 29 that its 2026 programme at the MPD copper-gold porphyry in southern British Columbia has been expanded from 6,500 metres to 16,500 metres with the mobilisation of a second drill rig. The newly arrived rig has been positioned in the southern part of the property where a completed 3D induced polarisation and audio-magnetotelluric survey has defined geophysical targets under the West, Adit, and South deposits for the first time. The initial phase focuses on Ketchan — a deposit Kodiak has not previously drilled — representing a genuine discovery target within an existing mineral resource footprint. First results are expected by August. In southern BC's copper-gold porphyry belt, a budget-funded jump from one to two rigs mid-season signals management conviction in the expanded target set and positions MPD for multiple result releases through year-end.

headline: INDEPENDENCE GOLD FINDS BLIND BALROG VEIN FROM GEOPHYSICS ALONE — NEW STRUCTURAL MODEL PREDICTS MORE HIDDEN VEINS AT 3TS BC (TSXV:IGO)
snippet: Independence Gold Corp. (TSXV:IGO) announced June 29 the discovery of a new gold-silver vein at the Balrog Target within the 3Ts Gold and Silver Project in central BC — a discovery made entirely through geophysical methods, with the vein sitting under approximately 30 metres of till and no surface expression whatsoever. The find is the first successful test of a district-scale structural model built from the company's 2025 airborne geophysical survey. The 3Ts Project lies 16 kilometres southwest of Artemis Gold's Blackwater Mine and hosts at least twenty known mineralised veins in a low-sulphidation epithermal district. A validated geophysical-to-drill workflow capable of locating veins beneath till dramatically expands the explorable area of a property where surface sampling has reached diminishing returns — and the structural model now predicts additional concealed targets across 35,486 hectares.

headline: CENTERRA GOLD DRILLS HEADWATER'S CRANE CREEK UNDER $25M EARN-IN — WESTERN IDAHO GOLD GETS MAJOR PARTNER (CSE:HWG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Headwater Gold Inc. (CSE:HWG)
snippet: Headwater Gold Inc. (CSE:HWG) announced June 29 that Centerra Gold has commenced drilling at the Crane Creek Gold Project in western Idaho under the US$25 million staged earn-in agreement signed in December 2025. Approximately US$1.7 million of Centerra's 2026 minimum commitment is being deployed following up shallow historical gold mineralisation, testing below outcropping gold-bearing veins, and stepping out along strike. Centerra can earn up to 70% by completing a Preliminary Economic Assessment, meaning technical risk for Headwater shareholders is now shared with a C$2 billion-plus gold producer at zero cost to the junior. For retail investors, a major mining company committing its own dollars to explore a junior's asset under an earn-in — rather than acquiring it outright — is one of the strongest geological endorsement signals available before a resource estimate exists.

headline: GEIGER ENERGY STARTS THELON BASIN URANIUM DRILL — LOKI UNCONFORMITY TARGET AT UNDER 200M DEPTH IN NUNAVUT (TSXV:BEEP)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Geiger Energy Corp. (TSXV:BEEP)
snippet: Geiger Energy Corp. (TSXV:BEEP) commenced its 10,000-metre summer drill programme June 29 at the Aberdeen Project in Nunavut's Thelon Basin, prioritising the Loki and Tatiggaq uranium discoveries. At Loki, Geiger's 2025 drilling intersected the first uranium mineralisation at the sandstone-unconformity contact in the Thelon Formation at less than 200 metres depth, accompanied by a large clay-alteration system characteristic of the Athabasca Basin's major deposits in Saskatchewan. Tatiggaq is a separate basement-hosted high-grade target. The Thelon Basin is geologically analogous to the Athabasca Basin — Proterozoic sedimentary cover over crystalline basement with similar structural controls — but represents a full exploration cycle behind Saskatchewan in drill density, meaning early-stage discoveries here face significantly less competition for claims and carry higher district-scale upside per exploration dollar than equivalent Athabasca Basin positions today.

headline: BELLEHELEN PROGRAMME COMPLETE: BROAD 100M PRECIOUS METALS ZONE OPEN AT DEPTH IN NEVADA — EXCALIBUR WRAPS 3,122M SPYGLASS PROGRAM (TSXV:SNG)
source_name: Yahoo Finance / Silver Range Resources Ltd. (TSXV:SNG) + Excalibur Metals Corp.
snippet: Silver Range Resources Ltd. (TSXV:SNG) announced June 29 the final drill results from Excalibur Metals' 3,122-metre reverse-circulation programme at Spyglass Ridge, Bellehelen Silver-Gold Project in Nye County, Nevada, completing the 10-hole campaign. Initial results from the first six holes — released June 3 — headlined with 360 g/t silver and 2.03 g/t gold over 1.52 metres within a 100.58-metre mineralised interval grading 16.7 g/t silver and 0.10 g/t gold from surface, with the first hole ending inside the mineralised zone and open at depth. Completion of the final four holes closes the programme definition phase and sets the drill-ready geometry for follow-up work testing the depth continuation of the broad zone. The Nevada jurisdiction positions Bellehelen's precious metals economics favourably relative to non-U.S. peers in the current domestic-premium environment.

headline: DOUBLEVIEW HAT EXTENDS 150M EAST WITH GOLD ENRICHMENT CONFIRMED — 2.42B LBS COPPER BASE FEEDS PFS PLANNING (TSXV:DBG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Doubleview Gold Corp. (TSXV:DBG)
snippet: Doubleview Gold Corp. (TSXV:DBG) reported June 29 that drilling at the Hat polymetallic project in northwestern BC has extended the mineralised envelope approximately 150 metres east beyond the previously defined resource boundary, confirming a gold-enriched zone including 16.6 metres at 2.05 g/t gold and 8.0 metres at 4.04 g/t gold. The Hat Project's Measured and Indicated resource currently includes 2.42 billion pounds of copper, 80 million pounds of cobalt, and 2,415 tonnes of scandium oxide. Drilling is targeting an updated Mineral Resource Estimate in early 2027 and informing active Pre-Feasibility Study planning. Each 150-metre eastward extension at Hat-level polymetallic grades adds meaningfully to what is already one of the largest undeveloped copper-cobalt-scandium deposits in British Columbia.

headline: BANK OF AMERICA JUNE FMS: GOLD LEAST OVERVALUED IN 2.5 YEARS — 58% OF MANAGERS EXPECT STAGFLATION, MINERS CHEAPEST ON RECORD VS. METAL
source_name: Canadian Mining Report / Bank of America Global Fund Manager Survey
snippet: Bank of America's June 2026 Global Fund Manager Survey — conducted June 5–11 across 198 institutional managers overseeing $540 billion in assets — found the net percentage of respondents viewing gold as 'overvalued' at its lowest reading since February 2024, after a 25% correction from January's $5,589 all-time high. Fifty-eight percent of managers expect stagflation, a macro regime that historically supports gold most strongly because slowing growth hits equities while persistent inflation supports the metal. The survey also finds gold mining stocks trading at their cheapest relative valuations versus the gold price itself in the modern bull cycle, with multiple senior producers at single-digit forward price-to-earnings multiples on models built at sub-$4,000 gold. Each of the prior two occasions the GFM survey registered its lowest gold 'overvalued' reading — 2019 and Q4 2022 — preceded significant gold and gold equity rallies within six to eighteen months. For investors who missed the 2025 run-up, the BofA data represents the closest institutional-consensus buy signal the 2026 correction cycle has produced.
